id: title:eli-r-ph:add a command to requeue person deletions that gave up

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a CLI entry point and helper functions for re-queuing failed person deletion tasks and logging state when deletion is exhausted, supporting recovery from transient failures and debugging, though the complete implementation and database migration are not supplied.
review.reason: Adds a Django management command `person_deletion requeue` and its implementation, a 24-hour window to deduplicate deletion activity logs, and a helper function to log the state of a person deletion task when it has exhausted its retry attempts. observations.behavior: Adds a new Django management command `person_deletion requeue` and its implementation.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a CLI entry point for re-queuing person deletions that previously failed, allowing the system to retry deleting persons that were not deleted after a previous attempt. This could help recover from transient failures or incomplete deletions.

observations.behavior: Adds a 24-hour window to deduplicate deletion activity logs, preventing duplicate entries for the same deletion.
